title: Structure and Properties of a Compound Formed by the Reaction of Molybdenum(II) Trifluoroacetate with 4,4′-Bipyridine
abstract: Abstract                The reaction of molybdenum(II) trifluoroacetate with 4,4′-bipyridine (bpy) in acetonitrile gave a pale yellow compound. The X-ray structural analysis of the compound showed that it consists of linear-chains formulated as [Mo2(O2CCF3)4·bpy]n and Mo2(O2CCF3)4·(bpy)2 dimers in the crystal.
